title: Yellow Crisp Chinese Goats Cheese Spring Rolls
description: A salty and crisp Chinese dish featuring goats cheese, perfect for a sick day, made with agemono deep fry method and dash friendly ingredients.
instructions: Heat the vegetable oil in a deep frying pan to 350 degrees Fahrenheit.
In a bowl, mix the crumbly goats cheese with soy sauce, sesame oil, scallions, salt, and pepper.
Lay a spring roll wrapper on a flat surface and place 1 tablespoon of the cheese mixture in the center of the wrapper.
Brush the edges of the wrapper with a small amount of water and fold the wrapper into a triangle, pressing the edges to seal.
Repeat the process with the remaining wrappers and cheese mixture.
Carefully place the spring rolls in the hot oil and fry until golden brown, about 3-4 minutes on each side.
Remove the spring rolls from the oil and place them on a paper towel-lined plate to drain excess oil.
Serve the yellow crisp Chinese goats cheese spring rolls hot and enjoy.
